title: Task
description: A work item in tasks/queue/. kind is optional and absent means "code" — so every pre-existing task file validates unchanged and the drain treats it exactly as before.

description.description: Full task body: spec references, files, acceptance tests, complexity

status.description: pending | in_progress | blocked | completed (written by the queue drainer)

kind.description: What kind of work this is. ABSENT means "code" everywhere; chore and note items are never claimed by the drain.

agent.description: Agent template that owns the task (new-style task files)

assignee.description: Agent that owns the task (legacy task files)

estimatedTokens.description: Rough token budget for the task. Optional — captured chore/note items carry none.

source.description: Where the task came from (e.g. openspec/business-os/tasks.md)

blockedBy.description: Task IDs that must complete first

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was created

claimedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when an agent claimed the task

claimedBy.description: Agent instance that claimed the task; null means unclaimed

testStatus.description: passing | failing (new-style task files); null means untested

blockedReason.description: Why the task is blocked, when status is blocked

files.description: Files the task is expected to touch (legacy task files)

phase.description: Phase/cycle the task belongs to (legacy task files)

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was created (legacy task files)

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task completed (legacy task files)
